title: King & Queen vs King
description: Drive the lone Black king to the edge of the board using the queen and king in tandem, avoiding stalemate traps.

title: King & Rook vs King
description: Use the rook to cut off ranks or files and combine with the king opposition to force checkmate on the edge.

title: King & Pawn vs King — Direct Opposition
description: With the White king already on the 6th rank in front of the pawn, outflank the Black king to escort the e-pawn to promotion.

title: Lucena Position — Building a Bridge
description: Force promotion by placing the White rook on the 4th rank (1.Rc4) to shield the king from vertical checks when stepping out.

title: Philidor Position — Third-Rank Defense
description: Hold the draw as Black by patrolling the 6th rank (1...Ra6!) until the pawn advances to e6, then switch to rear checks from the 1st rank.

title: Rook & Pawn vs Rook — Practical Endgame
description: Cut off the Black king and transition into a winning Lucena setup to convert the extra passed e-pawn.
